# **2 - IMPORT DATA**

## A. STATIONS - *FROM WATER CHEMISTRY BENCHMARKS SCRIPT*

```{r}
sulf <- read_excel('~/BioMonORDEQ/Benchmarks/Water Chemistry/cal.val_chem.ref.wq_2026-05-14.xlsx') %>%  # Output file from ref benchmarks script 
  filter(Char_Name == 'Sulfate') %>% 
  select(c(MLocID, Project1, StationDes, Lat_DD, Long_DD, SampleStartDate, Result_Numeric_mod, L2Eco, L3Eco, EcoRegion4, HUC8, ReferenceSite, cal_val, COMID)) %>% 
  mutate(Sulfate = Result_Numeric_mod) %>% 
  select(-Result_Numeric_mod)

comids <- sulf %>% 
  select(COMID) # Get just the COMIDs for next step
```

```{r pre-define inputs}

# Character vector of all human-influenced variables
HI_vars <- c("CANALDENSWS", "DAMDENSWS", "FERTWS", "MINEDENSWS", "NANIWS", "NPDESDENSWS", "PCTAGDRAINAGEWS", "PCTAGSLPMID2001WS", "PCTCROP2001WS", "PCTIMP2001WS", "PCTFRSTLOSS2002WS", "PCTNONAGINTRODMANAGVEGWS", "PCTURBHI2001WS", "PCTURBLO2001WS","PCTURBOP2001WS", "PESTIC1997WS", "POPDEN2010WS", "RDCRSSLPWTDWS", "RDCRSWS", "RDDENSWS", "SEPTICWS", "SUPERFUNDDENSWS", "TRIDENSWS", "WWTPALLDENSWS")
```

### OPTION 2: Read in SC data from pre-downloaded file.

```{r streamcat flat file}
sc_all <- read_excel("~/BioMonORDEQ/Benchmarks/Water Chemistry/SC_all_comids_2026-05-14.xlsx")
sc_all <- inner_join(sc_all, comids)  # only keep Sulfate COMIDs.
```

## C. OTHER PREDICTORS - *OUTSIDE OF STREAMCAT*

#### Erodible geology, NHD slope, stream power

```{r}
# ERODIBLE VS RESISTENT GEOLOGY (KEPT ERODIBLE, SINCE RESISTENT IS INVERSE OF ERODIBLE)
erod_resist_strmpow <- sc_all %>%
  mutate(PCT_EROD = PCTALLUVCOASTWS+PCTCARBRESIDWS+PCTCOASTCRSWS+PCTCOLLUVSEDWS+PCTEOLCRSWS+PCTEOLFINEWS+PCTGLACLAKECRSWS+PCTGLACLAKEFINEWS+PCTGLACTILCLAYWS+PCTGLACTILCRSWS+PCTGLACTILLOAMWS+PCTSALLAKEWS+PCTNONCARBRESIDWS)  %>% 
  mutate(PCT_RESIST = PCTALKINTRUVOLWS+PCTEXTRUVOLWS+PCTHYDRICWS+PCTSILICICWS) 

# SLOPE FROM NHD (TAKES 1-2 MIN)
# Note: do NOT push the downloaded file to GitHub as it's too large and will result in issues. Commit the ignore instead.
erod_resist_strmpow <- ORDEQBioassessment::get_NHD_info(erod_resist_strmpow) 

# WATERSHED AREA AND STREAM POWER
erod_resist_strmpow <- erod_resist_strmpow %>% 
  mutate(STRMPOW_CAT = totdasqkm + PRECIP9120WS * slope) %>%  # WSAREASQKM from SC, instead pulling totdasqkm from get_NHD (they are the same)
  select(COMID, PCT_EROD, STRMPOW_CAT, NHD_pSLOPE, SITE_TYPE) # Drop PCT_RESIST since it's the inverse of PCT_ERODE

# JOIN WITH OTHER PARAMETERS NOT FROM STREAMCAT
sulf_vars <- sc_all %>% 
  inner_join(erod_resist_strmpow, by='COMID') %>% # Join StreamCat data with erod_resist_strmpow data calulated above
  inner_join(sulf, by = 'COMID') # Join those with columns from AWQMS.

# RE-ORDER COLUMNS 
sulf_vars <- sulf_vars %>% 
  relocate(MLocID:Sulfate, .before = 'COMID') %>% 
  relocate(L2Eco:L3Eco, .after = SITE_TYPE) %>% 
  select(-c(HUC8, EcoRegion4)) 
```
#### Distance to coast
```{r}
# Done in ArcGIS Pro. Distance is in km.
coast_dist <- read_excel("//deqlab1//GIS_WA//Personal_Working_Folders//SBerzins//Dist_to_coast_All_sites.xls") %>% select(-c("OBJECTID", "StationDes","Lat_DD", "Long_DD", "NEAR_FID")) %>% rename(Coast_dist = NEAR_DIST) 

# Join to sulfate table
sulf_vars <- inner_join(coast_dist, sulf_vars, by = "MLocID") %>% 
  relocate(Coast_dist, .before = "PCT_EROD")
```

# **3 - PREPARE DATA FOR MODELS**

## A. HANDLE NA VALUES

#### IDENTIFY COLUMNS WITH MISSING DATA

```{r}
# FIND OUT WHICH COLUMNS HAVE NAs
sort(sapply(sulf_vars, function(x) sum(is.na(x))))

# THEN WRITE CODE FOR THEM IN ROUGH FIX SECTION BELOW.

# Note: Some predictors may have a large number of missing values (e.g., bankfull width, n = 63). Consider performing rough fix only for variables with ~10 or fewer missing values. This will avoid introducing error in the correlation matrix and variable selection phase.
```

#### PERFORM NA ROUGH FIX

```{r}
# PERFORM NA ROUGHFIX FUNCTION ON METRICS WITH ONLY A FEW MISSING VALUES (Leave metrics with >10 NAs [MAST2008, BMMI0809, WETTEDWITDTH, THALWEGDEPTH, BANKFULLWIDTH, BANKFULLDEPTH] until after the correlation table is built.)
sulf_vars$NSURPWS  <- na.roughfix(sulf_vars$NSURPWS) # 1 NA
sulf_vars$NANIWS  <- na.roughfix(sulf_vars$NANIWS) # 1 NA
sulf_vars$SW_FLUXWS  <- na.roughfix(sulf_vars$SW_FLUXWS) # 2 NA
sulf_vars$PCTIMPSLPHIGH2001WS  <- na.roughfix(sulf_vars$PCTIMPSLPHIGH2001WS) # 4 NA
sulf_vars$MWST2008  <- na.roughfix(sulf_vars$MWST2008) # 6 NA
```

## B. PREDICTOR VARIABLE SELECTION

#### Make Spearman correlation matrix to identify co-varied predictors (>0.8)

```{r, warning=FALSE}
# Subset numeric variables only
sulf_vars_num <- sulf_vars %>% 
  select(!c(SITE_TYPE:L3Eco)) %>% 
  select(!c(MLocID:Sulfate)) %>%  
  relocate(sort(names(.))) # sort columns alphabetically

# FULL CORRELATION MATRIX
spear <- cor(sulf_vars_num, method = "spearman", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
spear <- as.data.frame(spear)
spear.rows <- tibble::rownames_to_column(spear)

# CONDENSED CORRELATION MATRIX (>0.8 ONLY)
matrix <- spear.rows %>%  
  gather(-rowname, key = "colname", value = "cor") %>% 
  filter(abs(cor) > 0.8)

rm(list=c('spear', 'spear.rows'))
```

#### Export matrix and clean up in Excel

```{r}
# Export once, then clean up in Excel.
#write_xlsx(matrix, path = paste0("~/BioMonORDEQ/Benchmarks/Water Chemistry/Sulfate/SULF_Spearmans_Matrix", Sys.Date(), ".xlsx"))
```

#### Calculate coefficient of variance (CV), proportion of 0s, and kernel density plots to guide variable selection decisions

```{r}
# Calculate coefficient of variance (CV) for each predictor.
cv <- sulf_vars_num %>% 
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ cv(.x, na.rm = TRUE))) %>% 
  pivot_longer(1:141, names_to="Var", values_to="CV") # Change first argument to 1:# columns

# Calculate % of zeros for each predictor.
cv_pctzero <- sulf_vars_num %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ sum(. == 0, na.rm = TRUE) / n() * 100)) %>% 
  pivot_longer(1:141, names_to="Var", values_to="Percent Zeros") %>%  # Change  first argument to 1:# columns
  inner_join(cv, by = "Var")

# Write output to Excel for variable selection meeting.
#write_xlsx(cv_pctzero, path = "~/BioMonORDEQ/Benchmarks/Water Chemistry/Sulfate/Sulfate_CV.xlsx")
rm(cv)

# Make kernel density plots for predictors of interest to compare distributions.
sulf_vars %>%
    select("RUNOFFWS" , "SW_FLUXWS") %>%  # Edit this line to include vars that you want to look at.
  keep(is.numeric) %>% 
  gather() %>% 
  ggplot(aes(value)) +
  facet_wrap(~ key, scales = "free") +
  geom_density() +
  geom_rug()
```

#### Hold variable selection meeting

```{r}
# For Sulfate we did this as a group 4/1/2026.

# 1. Make a variable selection decisions sheet in Excel based on the TEMPLATE (Benchmarks >> Water Chemistry >> TEMPLATE_Var selection decisions.xlsx) and save to model folder on GitHub.

# 2. Clean up correlation matrix Excel table manually:
  # a) Filter data and delete rows where cor = 1.
  # b) Sort row names alphabetically.
  # c) Remove composite indexes (CHEM, CONN, HABT, HYD, ICI, IWI, SED, and TEMP).
  # d) Make a new matrix predictor decisions sheet based on the TEMPLATE (Benchmarks >> Water Chemistry >> TEMPLATE_Var selection correlations) and save to model folder on GitHub. 
  #     Copy row names into template (col A) and update formulas, column names into col G, and correlations into col L. 
  #     Add horizontal borders between groupings. 
  #     You may want to hide columns B and H (they are just for the formulas)

# 3. For each co-varied predictor(s), discuss ecological considerations and data distribution (CV, how well covers gradient, %0s).

# 4. Record which predictors to keep/remove and document rationale in the decisions sheet.

# 5. Remove predictors that have 100% zeros (no modeling power) and paste list of keepers below.
```

#### Update predictor list

```{r}
# Use Excel formula (=TEXTJOIN(", ", TRUE, range:range)) to compile list from decisions sheet and paste below.
sulf_vars_selected <- sulf_vars %>% 
  select(c(MLocID:COMID,BFIWS, CANALDENSWS, CAOWS, CLAYWS, COMPSTRGTHWS, DAMDENSWS, ELEVWS, FERTWS, HYDRLCONDWS, KFFACTWS, MINEDENSWS, MSST2008, NA2OWS, NANIWS, NHD_pSLOPE, NPDESDENSWS, NWS, OMWS, PCT_EROD, PCTAGDRAINAGEWS, PCTAGSLPMID2001WS, PCTALKINTRUVOLWS, PCTALLUVCOASTWS, PCTBL2001WS, PCTBURNAREA2002WS, PCTCOLLUVSEDWS, PCTCONIF2001WS, PCTCROP2001WS, PCTDECID2001WS, PCTEOLCRSWS, PCTEOLFINEWS, PCTEXTRUVOLWS, PCTFRSTLOSS2002WS, PCTGLACLAKECRSWS, PCTGLACLAKEFINEWS, PCTGLACTILCRSWS, PCTGRS2001WS, PCTHBWET2001WS, PCTICE2001WS, PCTIMP2001WS, PCTINCVEGRESP2002WS, PCTMXFST2001WS, PCTNONAGINTRODMANAGVEGWS, PCTOW2001WS, PCTSALLAKEWS, PCTSHRB2001WS, PCTURBHI2001WS, PCTURBLO2001WS, PCTURBOP2001WS, PCTWATERWS, PCTWDWET2001WS, PESTIC1997WS, POPDEN2010WS, RCKDEPWS, RDCRSSLPWTDWS, RDCRSWS, RDDENSWS, ROCKNWS, RUNOFFWS, SANDWS, SEPTICWS, SN2008WS, STRMPOW_CAT, SUPERFUNDDENSWS, SWS, TMAX9120WS, TRIDENSWS, WETINDEXWS, WTDEPWS, WWTPALLDENSWS, WWTPMAJORDENSWS, Coast_dist, SITE_TYPE:L3Eco)) %>% 
  relocate(COMID, .after = cal_val) %>% 
  mutate(logSULF = log(Sulfate)) %>% 
  relocate(logSULF, .before= Sulfate)
```

#### Perform final correlation check to ensure no co-varied predictors remain

```{r, warning=FALSE}
# Subset numeric variables only
sulf_vars_num_selected <- sulf_vars_selected %>% 
  select(!c(SITE_TYPE:L3Eco)) %>% 
  select(!c(MLocID:Sulfate)) 

# FULL CORRELATION MATRIX
spear2 <- cor(sulf_vars_num_selected, method = "spearman", use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
spear2 <- as.data.frame(spear2)
spear2.rows <- tibble::rownames_to_column(spear2)

# CONDENSED CORRELATION MATRIX (>0.8 ONLY)
matrix2 <- spear2.rows %>%  
  gather(-rowname, key = "colname", value = "cor") %>% 
  filter(abs(cor) > 0.8)

rm(list=c('spear2', 'spear2.rows', 'sulf_vars_num_selected'))

# ***OPEN NEWLY CREATED MATRIX AND CONTINUE ONLY IF NO CORRELATED VARIABLES REMAIN (ALL SHOULD BE 1)***
```

#### Clear out the environment

```{r}
rm(list=c('cv_pctzero', 'erod_resist_strmpow', 'matrix', 'matrix2', 'comids', 'sulf_vars', 'sulf_vars_num'))
```

# **5 - RANDOM FOREST MODELS**

## A. PREP RESPONSE DATA

```{r, include = TRUE, echo = FALSE}
# Select response data of interest
SULF <- sulf_vars_selected %>%
  select(-c(MLocID:COMID, Sulfate, SampleStartDate)) %>% #drop tp in favor of logSULF. Drop AWQMS columns too.
  as.data.frame()

# Convert character columns to factors
SULF[sapply(SULF, is.character)] <- lapply(SULF[sapply(SULF, is.character)], as.factor)

# Order factors
SULF$L2Eco <- factor(SULF$L2Eco, levels = c("Marine West Coast Forest", "Western Cordillera", "Cold Deserts"))
SULF$L3Eco <- factor(SULF$L3Eco, levels = c("Coast Range", "Willamette Valley", "Klamath Mountains", "Cascades", "Eastern Cascades Slopes and Foothills", "Columbia Plateau","Blue Mountains", "Northern Basin and Range", "Snake River Plain"))

# Look at response data by ecoregion
ggplot(SULF, aes(x=L3Eco, y = exp(logSULF))) + 
geom_boxplot() +
scale_y_log10() +
theme_bw() +
theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1)) +
labs(y = "Sulfate") +
geom_jitter(color="gray50", size=0.85, alpha=0.8) 

# 8/14/26 try dropping L2Eco and L3Eco from predictors
SULF <- SULF %>% 
  select(-c(L2Eco, L3Eco))
```

## B. FULL MODEL - ALL PREDICTORS INCLUDED

#### Model tuning - mtry and node size (number of trees happens in next step)

```{r}
#Adjust the parameters below based on tuning (nodesize = 6; mtry = 72)
full_tuning <- tune(logSULF~., SULF, seed = 1234)
full_tuning$optimal
```

#### Build full model

```{r, include = TRUE, echo = FALSE}
full <- rfsrc(logSULF ~ ., data = SULF, mtry = full_tuning$optimal[[2]], nodesize = full_tuning$optimal[[1]], importance = "TRUE", seed = 24)
full # Model output. (OOB) R squared = Percent Variance Explained.

# Mean squared error (transformed)
full_oob.mse <- tail(full$err.rate,1)
full_per.var <- 100 * (1 - full_oob.mse/ var(SULF$logSULF, na.rm = TRUE))
print(full_per.var)

range_SULF <- max(exp(SULF$logSULF)) - min(exp(SULF$logSULF))

#In-bag RMSE
full_rmse<- rmse(exp(full$predicted), exp(SULF$logSULF))
full_rmse.scaled <- full_rmse/range_SULF
print(paste0('In-bag RMSE = ' , round(full_rmse,2), " (μS/cm)"))
print(paste0('Scaled In-bag RMSE = ' , round(full_rmse.scaled*100,2), "%"))

#OOB RMSE
full_oob.rmse<- rmse(exp(full$predicted.oob), exp(SULF$logSULF))
full_oob.rmse.scaled <- full_oob.rmse/range_SULF
print(paste0('OOB RMSE = ' , round(full_oob.rmse,2), " (μS/cm)"))
print(paste0('Scaled OOB RMSE = ' , round(full_oob.rmse.scaled*100,2), "%"))

# Model tuning - How many trees? (default: 500)
#full$err.rate

# VIP
plot(full, plots.one.page=FALSE)
full_vimp <- sort(full$importance, decreasing = TRUE)[1:20]
par(mar=c(5,8.5,4,1)+.1)
barplot(full_vimp, horiz = TRUE, cex.names = 0.5, las = 1, main = "SULF Full model VIMP")

#print(vimp(full)$importance)

# Make a df for plots
full_pred.oob <- data.frame(obs = SULF$logSULF, pred = full$predicted.oob, predictions = "OOB") # The prediction is computed using only the trees in which that specific case was not used for training.
full_pred.ib <- data.frame(obs =SULF$logSULF, pred = full$predicted, predictions = "In-Bag") # This contains the predicted values for each case in the training data based on the entire ensemble (all trees). It uses the data that was "in-bag" (used to grow the trees) to determine the terminal node predictions.
full_plotdf <- rbind(full_pred.oob, full_pred.ib) %>% 
  mutate(obs = exp(obs)) %>% 
  mutate(pred = exp(pred)) %>% 
  mutate(delta = obs - pred)

# Plot
ggplot(data = full_plotdf, aes(x = pred, y = obs, color = predictions, shape = predictions)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.75) +
  labs(title = "SULF Full Model",
       x = "Predicted values (mg/L)",
       y = "Observed values (mg/L)") +
  theme_bw() + 
  geom_abline() + 
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  annotate("text", x = 0.6, y = 75, label = paste0('OOB RMSE = ' , round(full_oob.rmse,2), ' | scaled RMSE = ', round(full_oob.rmse.scaled*100,2), "%"), size = 3) +
    annotate("text", x = 0.6, y = 100, label = paste0('IB RMSE = ' , round(full_rmse,2), ' | scaled RMSE = ', round(full_rmse.scaled*100,2), "%"), size = 3) +
      annotate("text", x = 0.6, y = 130, label = paste0('% variance explained = ' , round(full_per.var,2), '%'), size = 3) 
```

#### Leaflet map of full model

```{r, include = TRUE, echo = FALSE}
# CREATE DF FOR MAPPING PURPOSES
# Need to join predictions to AWQMS columns, but there are no unique identifiers in the SULF table. Predictions will be in the same order as the SULF table initially.

# Find a StreamCat row that has ALL unique values
# any(duplicated(SULF$ELEVWS))  # Elevation works.
# any(duplicated(SULF$PRECIP9120WS))

# Join predictions to StreamCat table
full_obs.predict <- cbind(full_plotdf, SULF) %>% 
  filter(predictions == "OOB") %>% 
  arrange(ELEVWS) # Order by unique col

full_awqms <- sulf_vars_selected %>% 
  arrange(ELEVWS) %>% # Order by unique col
  relocate(L2Eco:L3Eco, .before = COMID) %>% 
  select(MLocID:logSULF) 

# Join pred with awqms table, and makes sure the SULF results match (Make sure logSULF column is the same as logSULF.1)
full_map <- cbind(full_obs.predict,full_awqms)

# Then select to remove duplicate logSULF column and reorder.
full_map <- full_map %>% 
  select(obs:COMID) %>% 
  relocate(MLocID:COMID, .before = obs)

map_function <- function(data) {
  leaflet() %>%
  addProviderTiles("OpenStreetMap", group = "Basic Map") %>% 
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldTopoMap, group = "Terrain") %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldImagery, group = "Satellite") %>%
  setView(lng = -120.5583, lat =44.0671, zoom =6.4) %>%
  addFullscreenControl(position = "topleft", pseudoFullscreen = FALSE) %>% 
  addCircleMarkers(data = data, group = "Observed", lng = ~data$Long_DD, 
                     lat = ~data$Lat_DD, fillColor = pal(data$obs), stroke = TRUE,
                   color = "#000", weight = 0.5, fillOpacity = 2, radius = 3, 
                   popup = paste0("<strong>", "MLocID: ","</strong>", data$MLocID, "<br>",
                                  "<strong>", "Station Description: ", "</strong>", data$StationDes, "<br>",
                                  "<strong>", "Project: ", "</strong>", data$Project1, "<br>",
                                  "<strong>", "Level 3 Ecoregion: ", "</strong>", data$L3Eco, "<br>",
                                  "<strong>", "Reference Status: ", "</strong>", data$ReferenceSite, "<br>",
                                  "<strong>", "Observed SULF: ", "</strong>", data$obs))  %>% 
      addCircleMarkers(data = data, group = "Predicted",lng = ~data$Long_DD, 
                     lat = ~data$Lat_DD, fillColor = pal2(data$pred), stroke = TRUE,
                   color = "#000", weight = 0.5, fillOpacity = 2, radius = 3, 
                   popup = paste0("<strong>", "MLocID: ","</strong>", data$MLocID, "<br>",
                                  "<strong>", "Station Description: ", "</strong>", data$StationDes, "<br>",
                                  "<strong>", "Project: ", "</strong>", data$Project1, "<br>",
                                  "<strong>", "Level 3 Ecoregion: ", "</strong>", data$L3Eco, "<br>",
                                  "<strong>", "Reference Status: ", "</strong>", data$ReferenceSite, "<br>",
                                  "<strong>", "Predicted SULF: ", "</strong>", data$pred))  %>% 
     addCircleMarkers(data = data, group = "Obs-Pred",lng = ~data$Long_DD, 
                     lat = ~data$Lat_DD, fillColor = pal3(data$delta), stroke = TRUE,
                   color = "#000", weight = 0.5, fillOpacity = 2, radius = 3, 
                   popup = paste0("<strong>", "MLocID: ","</strong>", data$MLocID, "<br>",
                                  "<strong>", "Station Description: ", "</strong>", data$StationDes, "<br>",
                                  "<strong>", "Project: ", "</strong>", data$Project1, "<br>",
                                  "<strong>", "Level 3 Ecoregion: ", "</strong>", data$L3Eco, "<br>",
                                  "<strong>", "Reference Status: ", "</strong>", data$ReferenceSite, "<br>",
                                  "<strong>", "Obs - Pred SULF: ", "</strong>", data$delta))  %>% 
    addLayersControl(
      baseGroups = c("Basic Map", "Terrain", "Satellite"),
      overlayGroups = c("Observed","Predicted", "Obs-Pred"),
      options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)) %>% 
    addLegend(pal = pal, group = "Observed", values = data$obs, position = "bottomright" , title = "Observed SULF" ) %>% 
    addLegend(pal = pal2,group = "Predicted",values = data$obs, position = "bottomright" , title = "Predicted SULF" ) %>%  # Keep values=data$obs here (instead of data$pred) to keep the legend colors scales the same between obs and pred.
        addLegend(pal = pal3, group = "Obs-Pred", values = data$delta, position = "bottomleft" , title = "Obs - Pred SULF" )
}

pal <- colorNumeric(palette = "Greens", 
  domain = c(0, max(full_map$obs)))
pal2 <- colorNumeric(palette = "Greens", 
  domain = c(0, max(full_map$obs)))
```

```{r,include = TRUE, echo = FALSE}
map_predictors <- function(data) {
  leaflet() %>%
  addProviderTiles("OpenStreetMap", group = "Basic Map") %>% 
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldTopoMap, group = "Terrain") %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldImagery, group = "Satellite") %>%
  setView(lng = -120.5583, lat =44.0671, zoom =6.4) %>%
  addFullscreenControl(position = "topleft", pseudoFullscreen = FALSE) %>% 
  addCircleMarkers(data = data, group = "WETINDEXWS", lng = ~data$Long_DD, 
                     lat = ~data$Lat_DD, fillColor = pal(data$WETINDEXWS), stroke = TRUE,
                   color = "#000", weight = 0.5, fillOpacity = 2, radius = 3, 
                   popup = paste0("<strong>", "MLocID: ","</strong>", data$MLocID, "<br>",
                                  "<strong>", "Station Description: ", "</strong>", data$StationDes, "<br>",
                                  "<strong>", "Project: ", "</strong>", data$Project1, "<br>",
                                  "<strong>", "Level 3 Ecoregion: ", "</strong>", data$L3Eco, "<br>",
                                  "<strong>", "Reference Status: ", "</strong>", data$ReferenceSite, "<br>",
                                  "<strong>", "WETINDEXWS: ", "</strong>", data$WETINDEXWS))  %>% 
      addCircleMarkers(data = data, group = "PCTCONIF2001WS",lng = ~data$Long_DD, 
                     lat = ~data$Lat_DD, fillColor = pal2(data$PCTCONIF2001WS), stroke = TRUE,
                   color = "#000", weight = 0.5, fillOpacity = 2, radius = 3, 
                   popup = paste0("<strong>", "MLocID: ","</strong>", data$MLocID, "<br>",
                                  "<strong>", "Station Description: ", "</strong>", data$StationDes, "<br>",
                                  "<strong>", "Project: ", "</strong>", data$Project1, "<br>",
                                  "<strong>", "Level 3 Ecoregion: ", "</strong>", data$L3Eco, "<br>",
                                  "<strong>", "Reference Status: ", "</strong>", data$ReferenceSite, "<br>",
                                  "<strong>", "PCTCONIF2001WS: ", "</strong>", data$PCTCONIF2001WS))  %>% 
     addCircleMarkers(data = data, group = "SWS",lng = ~data$Long_DD, 
                     lat = ~data$Lat_DD, fillColor = pal3(data$SWS), stroke = TRUE,
                   color = "#000", weight = 0.5, fillOpacity = 2, radius = 3, 
                   popup = paste0("<strong>", "MLocID: ","</strong>", data$MLocID, "<br>",
                                  "<strong>", "Station Description: ", "</strong>", data$StationDes, "<br>",
                                  "<strong>", "Project: ", "</strong>", data$Project1, "<br>",
                                  "<strong>", "Level 3 Ecoregion: ", "</strong>", data$L3Eco, "<br>",
                                  "<strong>", "Reference Status: ", "</strong>", data$ReferenceSite, "<br>",
                                  "<strong>", "SWS: ", "</strong>", data$SWS))  %>% 
     addCircleMarkers(data = data, group = "PCTCROP2001WS",lng = ~data$Long_DD, 
                     lat = ~data$Lat_DD, fillColor = pal4(data$PCTCROP2001WS), stroke = TRUE,
                   color = "#000", weight = 0.5, fillOpacity = 2, radius = 3, 
                   popup = paste0("<strong>", "MLocID: ","</strong>", data$MLocID, "<br>",
                                  "<strong>", "Station Description: ", "</strong>", data$StationDes, "<br>",
                                  "<strong>", "Project: ", "</strong>", data$Project1, "<br>",
                                  "<strong>", "Level 3 Ecoregion: ", "</strong>", data$L3Eco, "<br>",
                                  "<strong>", "Reference Status: ", "</strong>", data$ReferenceSite, "<br>",
                                  "<strong>", "PCTCROP2001WS: ", "</strong>", data$PCTCROP2001WS))  %>% 
     addCircleMarkers(data = data, group = "PCTEXTRUVOLWS",lng = ~data$Long_DD, 
                     lat = ~data$Lat_DD, fillColor = pal5(data$PCTEXTRUVOLWS), stroke = TRUE,
                   color = "#000", weight = 0.5, fillOpacity = 2, radius = 3, 
                   popup = paste0("<strong>", "MLocID: ","</strong>", data$MLocID, "<br>",
                                  "<strong>", "Station Description: ", "</strong>", data$StationDes, "<br>",
                                  "<strong>", "Project: ", "</strong>", data$Project1, "<br>",
                                  "<strong>", "Level 3 Ecoregion: ", "</strong>", data$L3Eco, "<br>",
                                  "<strong>", "Reference Status: ", "</strong>", data$ReferenceSite, "<br>",
                                  "<strong>", "PCTEXTRUVOLWS: ", "</strong>", data$PCTEXTRUVOLWS))  %>% 
    hideGroup(c("PCTCONIF2001WS","SWS", "PCTCROP2001WS", "PCTEXTRUVOLWS")) %>%  # Don't check all layers by default
    addLayersControl(
      baseGroups = c("Basic Map", "Terrain", "Satellite"),

      options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)) %>% 
    addLegend(pal = pal, group = "WETINDEXWS", values = data$WETINDEXWS, position = "bottomright" , title = "WETINDEXWS" ) %>% 
    addLegend(pal = pal2,group = "PCTCONIF2001WS",values = data$PCTCONIF2001WS, position = "bottomright" , title = "PCTCONIF2001WS" ) %>%
```

#### Reduce all human-influenced variables to 0 and make predictions using full model.

```{r,include = TRUE, echo = FALSE}
# Reduce all human-influenced vars to all 0s.
SULF_no.hi <- SULF %>% 
  mutate(across(all_of(HI_vars), ~0))

# Make predictions with adjusted human-influence to 0 
full_no.hi <- predict(full, newdata= SULF_no.hi, seed = 24)

# Mean squared error (untransformed)
full_mse_no.hi <- tail(full_no.hi$err.rate,1)
full_per.var_no.hi <- 100 * (1 - full_mse_no.hi/ var(SULF_no.hi$logSULF, na.rm = TRUE))

# RMSE
full_rmse_no.hi<- rmse(exp(full_no.hi$predicted), exp(SULF_no.hi$logSULF))
full_rmse.scaled_no.hi <- full_rmse_no.hi/range_SULF
print(paste0('OOB RMSE = ' , round(full_rmse_no.hi,2), " (μS/cm)"))
print(paste0('Scaled OOB RMSE = ' , round(full_rmse.scaled_no.hi*100,2), "%"))

# Make a df for plots
full_plotdf_no.hi <- data.frame(obs = SULF_no.hi$logSULF, pred = full_no.hi$predicted) %>% 
  mutate(obs = exp(obs)) %>% 
  mutate(pred = exp(pred)) %>% 
  mutate(delta = obs - pred)

# Plot
ggplot(data = full_plotdf_no.hi, aes(x = pred, y = obs)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.75) +
  labs(title = "SULF Full Model predictions without human influenced vars",
       x = "Predicted values (mg/L)",
       y = "Observed values (mg/L)") +
  theme_bw() + 
  geom_abline() + 
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  annotate("text", x =0.6, y = 40, label = paste0('OOB RMSE = ' , round(full_rmse_no.hi,2), ' | scaled RMSE = ', round(full_rmse.scaled_no.hi*100,2), "%"), size = 3)

# Plot residuals - full model, adjusted human-influenced vars to 0
full_resid_no.hi <- exp(SULF_no.hi$logSULF) - exp(full_no.hi$predicted) # Observed minus predicted oob
plot(full_resid_no.hi ~ exp(full_no.hi$predicted), xlab = "Predicted SULF (mg/L)", ylab = "Residuals (obs - pred)", main = "full model residuals, no HI vars")
abline(h=0, col = "red", lty = 2)
```

## C. Model Reduction

#### Model tuning - mtry and node size (number of trees happens in next step)

```{r}
# number of variables to include in the reduced model
nred <- 17

# build formula
red_vars <- as.formula(paste("logSULF~", paste(names(full_vimp)[1:nred], collapse = "+")))

#Adjust the parameters below based on tuning 
red17_tuning <- tune(red_vars, data = SULF, seed = 1234)
red17_tuning$optimal
```

#### Build model with Top red17 predictors

```{r,include = TRUE, echo = FALSE}
red17 <- rfsrc(red_vars, data = SULF, mtry = red17_tuning$optimal[[2]], nodesize = red17_tuning$optimal[[1]], importance = "TRUE", seed = 24)
red17 # Model output. (OOB) R squared = Percent Variance Explained.

# Mean squared error (untransformed)
red17_oob.mse <- tail(red17$err.rate,1)
red17_per.var <- 100 * (1 - red17_oob.mse/ var(SULF$logSULF, na.rm = TRUE))
print(red17_per.var)

#In-bag RMSE
red17_rmse<- rmse(exp(red17$predicted), exp(SULF$logSULF))
red17_rmse.scaled <- red17_rmse/range_SULF
print(paste0('In-bag RMSE = ' , round(red17_rmse,2), " (μS/cm)"))
print(paste0('Scaled In-bag RMSE = ' , round(red17_rmse.scaled*100,2), "%"))

#OOB RMSE
red17_oob.rmse<- rmse(exp(red17$predicted.oob), exp(SULF$logSULF))
red17_oob.rmse.scaled <- red17_oob.rmse/range_SULF
print(paste0('OOB RMSE = ' , round(red17_oob.rmse,2), " (μS/cm)"))
print(paste0('Scaled OOB RMSE = ' , round(red17_oob.rmse.scaled*100,2), "%"))

# Model tuning - How many trees? (default: 500)
#red17$err.rate

# VIP
plot(red17, plots.one.page=FALSE)
red17_vimp <- sort(red17$importance, decreasing = TRUE)[1:20]
par(mar=c(5,7,4,1)+.1)
barplot(red17_vimp, horiz = TRUE, cex.names = 0.5, las = 1, main = paste0("SULF Reduced (", nred, " variables) model VIMP"))

#print(vimp(red17)$importance)

# Make a df for plots
red17_pred.oob <- data.frame(obs = SULF$logSULF, pred = red17$predicted.oob, predictions = "OOB") # The prediction is computed using only the trees in which that specific case was not used for training.
red17_pred.ib <- data.frame(obs =SULF$logSULF, pred = red17$predicted, predictions = "In-Bag") # This contains the predicted values for each case in the training data based on the entire ensemble (all trees). It uses the data that was "in-bag" (used to grow the trees) to determine the terminal node predictions.
red17_plotdf <- rbind(red17_pred.oob, red17_pred.ib) %>% 
  mutate(obs = exp(obs)) %>% 
  mutate(pred = exp(pred)) %>% 
  mutate(delta = obs - pred)

# Plot
ggplot(data = red17_plotdf, aes(x = pred, y = obs, color = predictions, shape = predictions)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.75) +
  labs(title = paste0("SULF Red", nred, " Model"),
       x = "Predicted values (mg/L)",
       y = "Observed values (mg/L)") +
  theme_bw() + 
  geom_abline() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  annotate("text", x = 0.6, y = 100, label = paste0('OOB RMSE = ' , round(red17_oob.rmse,2), ' | scaled RMSE = ', round(red17_oob.rmse.scaled*100,2), "%"), size = 3) +
    annotate("text", x = 0.6, y = 130, label = paste0('IB RMSE = ' , round(red17_rmse,2), ' | scaled RMSE = ', round(red17_rmse.scaled*100,2), "%"), size = 3) +
      annotate("text", x = 0.6, y = 180, label = paste0('% variance explained = ' , round(red17_per.var,2), '%'), size = 3) 
```

#### Model tuning - mtry and node size (number of trees happens in next step)

```{r}
#Adjust the parameters below based on tuning (nodesize = 3; mtry = 4)
red4_tuning <- tune(logSULF ~ WETINDEXWS + PCTEXTRUVOLWS + SWS + CLAYWS, SULF, seed = 1234)
red4_tuning$optimal
```

```{r}
red4 <- rfsrc(logSULF ~ WETINDEXWS + PCTEXTRUVOLWS + SWS + CLAYWS, data = SULF, mtry = red4_tuning$optimal[[2]], nodesize = red4_tuning$optimal[[1]], importance = "TRUE", seed = 24)
red4 # Model output. (OOB) R squared = Percent Variance Explained.

# Mean squared error (untransformed)
red4_oob.mse <- tail(red4$err.rate,1)
red4_per.var <- 100 * (1 - red4_oob.mse/ var(SULF$logSULF, na.rm = TRUE))
print(red4_per.var)

#In-bag RMSE
red4_rmse<- rmse(exp(red4$predicted), exp(SULF$logSULF))
red4_rmse.scaled <- red4_rmse/range_SULF
print(paste0('In-bag RMSE = ' , round(red4_rmse,2), " (μS/cm)"))
print(paste0('Scaled In-bag RMSE = ' , round(red4_rmse.scaled*100,2), "%"))

#OOB RMSE
red4_oob.rmse<- rmse(exp(red4$predicted.oob), exp(SULF$logSULF))
red4_oob.rmse.scaled <- red4_oob.rmse/range_SULF
print(paste0('OOB RMSE = ' , round(red4_oob.rmse,2), " (μS/cm)"))
print(paste0('Scaled OOB RMSE = ' , round(red4_oob.rmse.scaled*100,2), "%"))

# Model tuning - How many trees? (default: 500)
#red4$err.rate

# VIP
plot(red4, plots.one.page=FALSE)
red4_vimp <- sort(red4$importance, decreasing = TRUE)[1:20]
par(mar=c(5,7,4,1)+.1)
barplot(red4_vimp, horiz = TRUE, cex.names = 0.5, las = 1, main = "SULF Reduced (4 variables) model VIMP")

#print(vimp(red4)$importance)

# Make a df for plots
red4_pred.oob <- data.frame(obs = SULF$logSULF, pred = red4$predicted.oob, predictions = "OOB") # The prediction is computed using only the trees in which that specific case was not used for training.
red4_pred.ib <- data.frame(obs =SULF$logSULF, pred = red4$predicted, predictions = "In-Bag") # This contains the predicted values for each case in the training data based on the entire ensemble (all trees). It uses the data that was "in-bag" (used to grow the trees) to determine the terminal node predictions.
red4_plotdf <- rbind(red4_pred.oob, red4_pred.ib) %>% 
  mutate(obs = exp(obs)) %>% 
  mutate(pred = exp(pred)) %>% 
  mutate(delta = obs - pred)

# Plot
ggplot(data = red4_plotdf, aes(x = pred, y = obs, color = predictions, shape = predictions)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.75) +
  labs(title = "SULF red4 Model",
       x = "Predicted values (mg/L)",
       y = "Observed values (mg/L)") +
  theme_bw() + 
  geom_abline() +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  annotate("text", x = 0.6, y = 100, label = paste0('OOB RMSE = ' , round(red4_oob.rmse,2), ' | scaled RMSE = ', round(red4_oob.rmse.scaled*100,2), "%"), size = 3) +
    annotate("text", x = 0.6, y = 140, label = paste0('IB RMSE = ' , round(red4_rmse,2), ' | scaled RMSE = ', round(red4_rmse.scaled*100,2), "%"), size = 3) +
      annotate("text", x = 0.6, y = 190, label = paste0('% variance explained = ' , round(red4_per.var,2), '%'), size = 3) 
```

## E. Reference-Only Model

#### Subset the data

```{r}
SULF.ref <- sulf_vars_selected %>% 
  filter(ReferenceSite=="REFERENCE") %>% 
  select(-c(MLocID:COMID, Sulfate, SampleStartDate))  %>%  # Remove AWQMS columns
  select(-all_of(HI_vars)) %>%  # Remove anthropogenic StreamCat vars
  as.data.frame()

# Convert character columns to factors
SULF.ref[sapply(SULF.ref, is.character)] <- lapply(SULF.ref[sapply(SULF.ref, is.character)], as.factor)
```

#### Model tuning - mtry and node size (number of trees happens in next step)

```{r}
#Adjust the parameters below based on tuning (nodesize = 1; mtry = 20)
ref_tuning <- tune(logSULF~., SULF.ref, seed = 2)
ref_tuning$optimal
```

#### Build full ref-only model

```{r,include = TRUE, echo = FALSE}
ref <- rfsrc(logSULF ~ ., data = SULF.ref, mtry = ref_tuning$optimal[[2]], nodesize = ref_tuning$optimal[[1]], importance = "TRUE", seed = 24)
ref # Model output. (OOB) R squared = Percent Variance Explained.

# Mean squared error (untransformed)
ref_oob.mse <- tail(ref$err.rate,1)
ref_per.var <- 100 * (1 - ref_oob.mse/ var(SULF.ref$logSULF, na.rm = TRUE))
print(ref_per.var)

ref_range_SULF <- max(exp(SULF.ref$logSULF)) - min(exp(SULF.ref$logSULF))

#In-bag RMSE
ref.rmse<- rmse(exp(ref$predicted), exp(SULF.ref$logSULF))
ref_rmse.scaled <- ref.rmse/ref_range_SULF
print(paste0('In-bag RMSE = ' , round(ref.rmse,2), " (μS/cm)"))
print(paste0('Scaled In-bag RMSE = ' , round(ref_rmse.scaled*100,2), "%"))

#OOB RMSE
ref_oob.rmse<- rmse(exp(ref$predicted.oob), exp(SULF.ref$logSULF))
ref_oob.rmse.scaled <- ref_oob.rmse/ref_range_SULF
print(paste0('OOB RMSE = ' , round(ref_oob.rmse,2), " (μS/cm)"))
print(paste0('Scaled OOB RMSE = ' , round(ref_oob.rmse.scaled*100,2), "%"))

# Model tuning - How many trees? (default: 500)
#ref$err.rate

# VIP
plot(ref, plots.one.page=FALSE)
ref_vimp <- sort(ref$importance, decreasing = TRUE)[1:20]
par(mar=c(5,7,4,1)+.1)
barplot(ref_vimp, horiz = TRUE, cex.names = 0.5, las = 1, main = "SULF Full Reference-Only Model VIMP")

#print(vimp(ref)$importance)

# Make a df for plots
ref_pred.oob <- data.frame(obs = SULF.ref$logSULF, pred = ref$predicted.oob, predictions = "OOB") # The prediction is computed using only the trees in which that specific case was not used for training.
ref_pred.ib <- data.frame(obs =SULF.ref$logSULF, pred = ref$predicted, predictions = "In-Bag") # This contains the predicted values for each case in the training data based on the entire ensemble (all trees). It uses the data that was "in-bag" (used to grow the trees) to determine the terminal node predictions.
ref_plotdf<- rbind(ref_pred.oob, ref_pred.ib) %>% 
  mutate(obs = exp(obs)) %>% 
  mutate(pred = exp(pred)) %>% 
  mutate(delta = obs - pred)

# Plot
ggplot(data = ref_plotdf, aes(x = pred, y = obs, color = predictions, shape = predictions)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.75) +
  labs(title = "SULF Full Reference-Only Model",
       x = "Predicted values (mg/L)",
       y = "Observed values (mg/L)") +
  theme_bw() + 
  geom_abline() + 
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  annotate("text", x = 0.75, y = 15, label = paste0('OOB RMSE = ' , round(ref_oob.rmse,2), ' | scaled RMSE = ', round(ref_oob.rmse.scaled*100,2), "%"), size = 3) +
    annotate("text", x = 0.75, y = 20, label = paste0('IB RMSE = ' , round(ref.rmse,2), ' | scaled RMSE = ', round(ref_rmse.scaled*100,2), "%"), size = 3) +
      annotate("text", x = 0.75, y = 25, label = paste0('% variance explained = ' , round(ref_per.var,2), '%'), size = 3) 

# Plot residuals - 
ref_resid <- exp(SULF.ref$logSULF) - exp(ref$predicted) # Observed minus predicted oob
plot(ref_resid ~ exp(ref$predicted), xlab = "Predicted SULF (mg/L)", ylab = "Residuals (obs - pred)", main = "Ref only model residuals")
abline(h=0, col = "red", lty = 2)
```

```{r, include = TRUE, echo = FALSE}
# CREATE DF FOR MAPPING PURPOSES
# Need to join predictions to AWQMS columns, but there are no unique identifiers in the SULF table. Predictions will be in the same order as the SULF table initially.

# Find a StreamCat row that has ALL unique values
# any(duplicated(SULF$ELEVWS))  # Elevation works.
# any(duplicated(SULF$PRECIP9120WS))

# Join predictions to StreamCat table
ref_obs.predict <- cbind(ref_plotdf, SULF.ref) %>% 
  filter(predictions == "OOB") %>% 
  arrange(ELEVWS) # Order by unique col

ref_awqms <- sulf_vars_selected %>% 
  arrange(ELEVWS) %>% # Order by unique col
  filter(ReferenceSite=='REFERENCE') %>% 
  select(MLocID:logSULF) 

# Join obs.predict and awqms tables, and makes sure the SULF results match (Make sure logSULF column is the same as logSULF.1)
ref_map <- cbind(ref_obs.predict, ref_awqms)

# Then select to remove duplicate logSULF column and reorder.
ref_map <- ref_map %>% 
  select(obs:COMID) %>% 
  relocate(MLocID:COMID, .before = obs)

  domain = c(0, max(ref_map$obs)))
```

## F. Make comparisons of predictions

#### Compare reduced model (adjusted and unadjusted) by ecoregion

```{r,include = TRUE, echo = FALSE, warning=FALSE, fig.dim = c(12, 7)}
# Construct a dataframe of predictions to compare
boxplot_preds <- data.frame(MLocID = red17_map$MLocID, StationDes = red17_map$StationDes, Obs = red17_map$obs, Pred_reduced = red17_map$pred, L3Eco = as.character(red17_map$L3Eco),Pred_adj = red17_map_no.hi$pred, Ref = red17_map$ReferenceSite, Pred_full = full_map$pred)

boxplot_ref<- ref_map %>%
  select(MLocID, Pred_ref = pred, Obs_ref_only = obs)

boxplot_combo <- left_join(boxplot_preds, boxplot_ref, by="MLocID")

boxplot_df <- gather(boxplot_combo, key = "Model", value = "Prediction", Pred_reduced, Pred_adj, Pred_ref, Pred_full, Obs, Obs_ref_only)
boxplot_df$Model <- factor(boxplot_df$Model, levels = c("Obs_ref_only", "Pred_ref", "Pred_adj","Pred_reduced","Pred_full", "Obs"))
boxplot_df$L3Eco <- factor(boxplot_df$L3Eco, levels = c("Coast Range", "Willamette Valley", "Klamath Mountains", "Cascades", "Eastern Cascades Slopes and Foothills", "Columbia Plateau","Blue Mountains", "Northern Basin and Range", "Snake River Plain"))

# Clean out environment
rm=(c("boxplot_preds", "boxplot_ref", "boxplot_combo"))

ggplot(boxplot_df, aes(x = L3Eco, y = Prediction, fill = Model)) + 
  geom_boxplot() +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  guides(x = guide_axis(angle = 45)) +
  scale_y_log10() +
  theme_bw(base_size=14) + ylab("SULF (mg/L)") +
   stat_summary(
    fun.data = function(x) data.frame(y = median(x), label = length(x)),
    geom = "text",
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.75),
    vjust = -0.5,
    size = 2.5
  )
```

#### Combined Leaflet map of predictions

```{r, include = TRUE, echo = FALSE}
leaflet_df <- left_join(boxplot_df, sulf %>%  select(MLocID, Project1, Lat_DD, Long_DD), by = "MLocID") %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = Model, values_from = Prediction) %>% 
  relocate(Obs, .before= Pred_reduced)

map_all <- function(data) {
  leaflet() %>%
  addProviderTiles("OpenStreetMap", group = "Basic Map") %>% 
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldTopoMap, group = "Terrain") %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldImagery, group = "Satellite") %>%
  setView(lng = -120.5583, lat =44.0671, zoom =6.4) %>%
  addFullscreenControl(position = "topleft", pseudoFullscreen = FALSE) %>%
  addCircleMarkers(data = data, group = "Observed", lng = ~data$Long_DD, 
                     lat = ~data$Lat_DD, fillColor = pal(data$Obs), stroke = TRUE,
                   color = "#000", weight = 0.5, fillOpacity = 2, radius = 3, 
                   popup = paste0("<strong>", "MLocID: ","</strong>", data$MLocID, "<br>",
                                  "<strong>", "Station Description: ", "</strong>", data$StationDes, "<br>",
                                  "<strong>", "Project: ", "</strong>", data$Project1, "<br>",
                                  "<strong>", "Level 3 Ecoregion: ", "</strong>", data$L3Eco, "<br>",
                                  "<strong>", "Reference Status: ", "</strong>", data$Ref, "<br>",
                                  "<strong>", "Observed SULF: ", "</strong>", data$Obs))  %>% 
      addCircleMarkers(data = data, group = "Pred_reduced",lng = ~data$Long_DD, 
                     lat = ~data$Lat_DD, fillColor = pal2(data$Pred_reduced), stroke = TRUE,
                   color = "#000", weight = 0.5, fillOpacity = 2, radius = 3, 
                   popup = paste0("<strong>", "MLocID: ","</strong>", data$MLocID, "<br>",
                                  "<strong>", "Station Description: ", "</strong>", data$StationDes, "<br>",
                                  "<strong>", "Project: ", "</strong>", data$Project1, "<br>",
                                  "<strong>", "Level 3 Ecoregion: ", "</strong>", data$L3Eco, "<br>",
                                  "<strong>", "Reference Status: ", "</strong>", data$Ref, "<br>",
                                  "<strong>", "Predicted SULF UNADJUSTED (reduced model): ", "</strong>", data$Pred_reduced))  %>% 
     addCircleMarkers(data = data, group = "Pred_adj",lng = ~data$Long_DD, 
                     lat = ~data$Lat_DD, fillColor = pal3(data$Pred_adj), stroke = TRUE,
                   color = "#000", weight = 0.5, fillOpacity = 2, radius = 3, 
                   popup = paste0("<strong>", "MLocID: ","</strong>", data$MLocID, "<br>",
                                  "<strong>", "Station Description: ", "</strong>", data$StationDes, "<br>",
                                  "<strong>", "Project: ", "</strong>", data$Project1, "<br>",
                                  "<strong>", "Level 3 Ecoregion: ", "</strong>", data$L3Eco, "<br>",
                                  "<strong>", "Reference Status: ", "</strong>", data$Ref, "<br>",
                                  "<strong>", "Predicted SULF ADJUSTED: ", "</strong>", data$Pred_adj))  %>% 
     addCircleMarkers(data = data, group = "Pred_ref",lng = ~data$Long_DD, 
                     lat = ~data$Lat_DD, fillColor = pal4(data$Pred_ref), stroke = TRUE,
                   color = "#000", weight = 0.5, fillOpacity = 2, radius = 3, 
                   popup = paste0("<strong>", "MLocID: ","</strong>", data$MLocID, "<br>",
                                  "<strong>", "Station Description: ", "</strong>", data$StationDes, "<br>",
                                  "<strong>", "Project: ", "</strong>", data$Project1, "<br>",
                                  "<strong>", "Level 3 Ecoregion: ", "</strong>", data$L3Eco, "<br>",
                                  "<strong>", "Reference Status: ", "</strong>", data$Ref, "<br>",
                                  "<strong>", "Predicted SULF REF ONLY: ", "</strong>", data$Pred_ref))  %>% 
    addLayersControl(
      baseGroups = c("Basic Map", "Terrain", "Satellite"),
      overlayGroups = c("Observed","Pred_reduced", "Pred_adj", "Pred_ref"),
      options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)) %>% 
    addLegend(pal = pal, group = "Observed", values = data$Obs, position = "bottomright" , title = "Observed SULF" ) %>% 
    addLegend(pal = pal2,group = "Pred_reduced",values = data$Obs, position = "bottomright" , title = "Predicted SULF (UNADJUSTED)" ) %>%  # Keep values=data$Obs here (instead of data$pred) to keep the legend colors scales the same between obs and pred.
        addLegend(pal = pal3, group = "Pred_adj", values = data$Pred_adj, position = "bottomleft" , title = "Predicted SULF (ADJUSTED)" ) %>% 
        addLegend(pal = pal4, group = "Pred_ref", values = data$Pred_adj, position = "bottomleft" , title = "Predicted SULF (REF ONLY)" )    # Keep values=data$Pred_adj here (instead of data$Ref) to keep the legend colors scales the same between ref expectations.
}
```
